evaluations.questionText: Explain the role of mitochondria in a cell.
evaluations.studentAnswerDisplay: They produce energy for the cell in the form of ATP during cellular respiration, acting like the cell power generator.
evaluations.correctAnswerDisplay: Mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell because they generate most of the cell supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), used as a source of chemical energy through cellular respiration.
